Replace the old figures/action entirely: one seated caregiver at lower right holds an awake newborn face to face, baby's body resting comfortably along both adult forearms and its head visibly cradled in the adult's hands. Show a quiet listening pause, adult attentive and baby naturally alert, without a performance smile. Make the hands, forearms and supported newborn anatomy clear and believable. Keep figures below/right of the upper-left 45% headline area; no face or hand in that space. A small muted teal floor mat is enough. No ball, toys, equipment, chair, room, text, lettering or labels. Actual transparent alpha outside the painted figures and mat, no rectangular paper backdrop or glowing halo. Create one new original scene using the reference only as style/composition, not book artwork.

Remove every checker square and all background texture, including enclosed gaps. Keep the illustrated people, expressions, supported baby, hands, clothes, pose, mat/ground and exact composition unchanged. Do not use transparency or a transparency pattern. Do not paint paper texture, a halo, a gradient or a shadow into the white background. One landscape 1536x1024 illustration on solid WHITE.

Use case: illustration-story. Rework this existing illustration into a sibling age-guide scene, preserving its textured gouache/colored-pencil storybook rendering, warm teal/coral/ochre/sage colors, expressive rounded faces and 1536x1024 landscape composition. Replace the ball-reaching scene with a small peekaboo exchange: adult seated low on the right, bringing their two open hands away from their OWN face, looking warmly toward a baby at lower center-left. Baby lies comfortably on their tummy, forearms on a simple deep-teal mat, looking toward the adult; no propping into sitting, no cloth, no object to find. Baby and adult need not smile on cue. Clear believable hands/arms; adult's face remains visible between the opening hands. Full figures, no room or furnishing. Keep the top-left 45% completely empty for a webpage headline. Crucial background requirement: perfectly flat pure white RGB 255,255,255 everywhere outside the painted figures and mat. No checkerboard, no texture on the background, no vignette, no cast halo, no transparency pattern, no lettering or labels. Keep the pencil texture ONLY inside the painted subjects.

Rework the reference into a new sibling illustration for a 12–18 month age guide. Same textured gouache/colored-pencil storybook style, expressive rounded faces, teal/coral/ochre/sage colors, landscape 1536x1024. A young toddler sits naturally on the floor at lower center-left beside one small ordinary basket containing a shoe; the child lifts the other shoe from the basket with curiosity. At right a caregiver with warm brown skin and dark curly hair kneels nearby, calmly helping with the shared getting-ready moment, holding one separate adult hand open without pulling the child's body. Only the child, caregiver, basket and one pair of small shoes; no shelf, table, stairs or extra materials. Believable separated fingers, shoe shapes and grounded bodies. Keep upper-left 45% empty for a webpage headline, with figures grouped low and to the right. Flat pure WHITE RGB(255,255,255) background outside the painted figures and small ground patch. No transparency/checker pattern, no background texture, room, gradient, halo, labels or text. Warm ordinary partial participation, no achievement pose.

Rework the reference into a new sibling illustration for a 2–3 year age guide. Same textured gouache/colored-pencil storybook style, warm teal/coral/ochre/sage palette, expressive rounded faces, landscape 1536x1024. A toddler standing with both feet on the floor at lower center-left explores wiping a LOW closed window pane with a small squeegee. The reachable pane has a simple warm-wood frame; its top stays below the midpoint of the image so the upper-left remains open. At right, a caregiver kneels at the child's level, sharing the work and holding a plain small cloth. A small simple unlabelled water spray bottle rests on the floor near the adult, away from faces. Natural unfinished wiping movement with a few faint water streaks; clear believable hands and separate squeegee/cloth. No climbing, stool, platform, glass-cleaning product, vinegar bottle, open window, quiz or perfect finished chore. The window is a spare illustrated fragment, no entire room. Keep the upper-left 45% fully empty for a webpage headline. Flat pure WHITE RGB(255,255,255) outside the painted people/window/ground touch. No background texture, transparency/checker pattern, cast halo, gradients, text or labels.

Use case: illustration-story. Rework the reference into a small close-up illustration for a Montessori guide’s dressing reader. Preserve the exact soft textured gouache/colored-pencil style and teal, sage, warm ochre and coral palette. Show the helpful action clearly: a seated toddler is putting one socked foot into a roomy low shoe, while an adult hand gently holds open the BACK of that shoe. The toddler moves their own foot; the adult does not grip or push the child’s leg. Show only the lower legs, shoe, adult supporting hand and a little of the adult forearm/knee, with no faces or full bodies. One clear child foot, one simple wide-opening shoe, one visible adult hand; believable distinct anatomy and clear heel opening. The illustration explains a small division of effort, not a completed dressing achievement. Center the action with generous white margin. Landscape 1536x1024. Flat pure WHITE RGB(255,255,255) background; no checkerboard, transparency pattern, labels, arrows, text, border, room, gradient or halo. Texture belongs only to the painted figures and shoe.
